gaps.reason: Iris, Frame and Plaza are priced from their SKUs (table 542, pricing-v2), but the product has not confirmed their palettes, nor the $990 price of a white Frame against the Hastings site.
A Solid Surface colour does not say whether it is Technolite, Technomood or Texturizzato. It is priced as SSTL, which costs the same per cm as SSTM and SSTEX, unless the basin decides the material.
Organizers are priced once per drawer that has a divider style; whether $170 / $150 is the price of one organizer is not confirmed.
Class sells thick tops (Solid Surface and Porcelain 4.7, HPL 4), but the profile has no thickness choice yet, so tops are priced thin. Porcelain thin is 3/4 in the catalog and 0.8 in the SKU.
Every thick top takes two CT-GB-BRKT; the count for a composition with more than one top is not confirmed.
